title: Intracellular competitions reveal the combination of active partitioning and addiction mechanisms as most advantageous for low-copy plasmid fitness
authors: Effe J; Santer M; Wang Y; Feenstra TE; Hülter NF; Dagan T
one_liner_zh: 该文研究质粒持久性策略（主动分配与毒素-抗毒素系统）的进化优势，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Extrachromosomal and mobile genetic elements, including transposable elements, plasmids, and accessory chromosomes, are found across all domains of life. The replication and segregation of elements integrated into the host chromosome are ensured by the host life cycle. In contrast, the persistence of autonomously replicating elements relies on their ability to remain within the host population. Here, we compare the evolutionary advantage of different persistence strategies found in prokaryotic plasmids. Through intracellular competitions between plasmid genotypes, we find that the combination of active partitioning during cell division with a toxin-antitoxin (TA) system for post-segregational killing increases plasmid fitness more than either strategy alone. Mathematical modeling of long-term plasmid evolution, calibrated with empirical plasmid loss dynamics, further supports these findings. A survey of enterobacterial genomes indicates that partitioning and TA systems are core features of large conjugative plasmids. Indeed, we confirm the presence of a previously unrecognized type I TA system in IncX3 plasmids, which serve as important vectors of antibiotic resistance in human pathogens. These findings suggest that large conjugative plasmids encode TA systems, including those yet to be identified. The combination of TA and partitioning systems emerges as the most effective strategy for the evolutionary success of low-copy extrachromosomal elements.
abstract_zh: 染色体外和移动遗传元件，包括转座元件、质粒和附属染色体，存在于所有生命域中。整合到宿主染色体中的元件的复制和分离由宿主生命周期确保。相比之下，自主复制元件的持久性依赖于其在宿主群体中留存的能力。在此，我们比较了原核质粒中不同持久性策略的进化优势。通过质粒基因型之间的细胞内竞争，我们发现，细胞分裂期间主动分配与毒素-抗毒素（toxin-antitoxin, TA）系统用于分离后杀伤的组合，比任一策略单独使用更能提高质粒适应性。基于经验质粒丢失动态校准的长期质粒进化数学模型进一步支持这些发现。对肠杆菌基因组的调查表明，分配和TA系统是大尺寸接合质粒的核心特征。确实，我们确认了IncX3质粒中存在一种先前未被识别的I型TA系统，这些质粒是人类病原体中抗生素耐药性的重要载体。这些发现表明，大尺寸接合质粒编码TA系统，包括那些尚未被识别的系统。TA与分配系统的组合成为低拷贝染色体外元件进化成功的最有效策略。
